scheme_name: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
other_conditions: Born and residing in Goa for at least 15 years (preference), but the scheme does not bar others.
benefits_summary: Cash prizes of ₹20,000, ₹16,000 and ₹12,000 per category, plus five consolation prizes of ₹2,000, certificates and exhibition opportunities for selected entries.
